title: logdig
pitch: Turn your coding agent history into a daily journal you can read.
description: Backfill a week of work in parallel, keep the short version in your notes and click a timestamp for the details. Your handwritten notes are never overwritten, and it works with Obsidian or plain Markdown.

externals.name: LLM summaries via Pi
externals.note: Sessions are synthetic and a stand-in for Pi returns canned summaries, so nothing is sent to a model.
